dimensions.scope: limited: identified single operating object; broad: evidenced wider affected scope; unknown: scope unsupported
dimensions.materiality: minor: bounded marginal consequence with basis; substantive: evidenced operating/fulfillment consequence and comparison; unknown: magnitude or baseline insufficient
dimensions.urgency: near_term: identified imminent trigger; long_term: identified later horizon; unknown: no timing basis

high: All dimensions known, substantive operating mechanism, explicit comparison basis and necessary conditions; scale alone or promotional adjectives never suffice.
medium: Known dimensions and an explained operating mechanism of meaningful but bounded extent; no claim of calibrated return.
low: Known dimensions and explained limited marginal consequences; unknown information must not default to low.
unknown: Scope/materiality/timing or mechanism lacks evidence; retain explicit gaps.
routing: Valid high -> important_pending_review with unverified premise; explained medium/low with known dimensions -> ordinary_tracking; unknown or missing dimensions/mechanism -> insufficient_information. Invalid high remains invalid_pending_review, not credible alert.
limits: Model proposals only; checks establish references and structural prerequisites, not semantic grade accuracy. Support count is not truth, impact, or independent-source evidence.
